review.purpose: Global first-stage actionable source-state handoff; implementation designs and technical expansion follow separately.
review.change_scope: This review adds only REPOSITORY_REVIEW.json to tracked scope. Probes/logs are local ignored audit artifacts. Product source, tests and historical evidence are unchanged.

priority_legend.P1: Fix or resolve before the real-study/release gate affected by the finding.
priority_legend.P2: Important correctness, reproducibility or operational work; schedule after immediate blockers.
priority_legend.P3: Conditional legacy research or future scope; not authority to postpone the real-reference gate.

review.confidence_rule: Category 3 requires a concrete counterexample or an explicit source/contract contradiction. Unverified behavior is in category 2 and labeled. Intentional templates and fixtures are not defective implementations.
review.scope_boundary: Every Python source module is inventoried below. Active paths and legacy numerical APIs received static review; focused probes supplement the unchanged-fingerprint full suites. Synthetic labs and historical support scripts were reviewed for structure, role and evidence boundaries, not independently re-proven line by line. Binary images, archives and retained evidence were reviewed by inventories/digests and selected records, not by reinterpreting every historical output.
not_claimed: Complete security audit or formal mathematical proof
Live native inference or human-reference acceptance
Passing final qualification or unchanged-array qualification validation on Windows
That historical Linux results are incorrect because a different current Windows stack fails

global_state.state: Implemented research instrument with substantial retained tests/evidence; current Windows qualification/release gate failing; real native independent-reference gate incomplete.
architecture: development-only bias/scatter -> calibration-only category radii -> frozen held-out admission
same observations/error model -> shared reference8 intrinsic relations -> typed bundle, raw arrays, journal, verify/replay
implemented: Immutable bytes-backed active observation arrays and full shape/dtype-aware hashes
Proper-rotation shared registration, source support masks and explicit missingness
Source-pixel measurement and complete-group routing without pooled unsupported-category fallback
Prediction-free workbenches, append-only annotation revisions and prospective study freeze
Bounded subprocess attempt accounting and retained native output contracts
Joint full16 development scatter, independent source radii and conservative dependent relation bounds
All-required-category admission and full-enrollment query/context leakage checks
Self-contained reports, bundle manifests and numerical replay
invariants_to_preserve: Stored-raster pixel centers; no silent EXIF display-coordinate substitution
One authoritative Observation pair and CanonicalState; no second scoring/alignment pipeline
Raw observed arrays are never replaced with error-model centers
Proper rotations exclude reflection; uncertain reference eye spans remain uncertain
Shared landmark dependencies, missingness and fixed declared denominators survive exports
Development fits; calibration sets radii; evaluation is frozen and cannot retune
A radius stays bound to its fitted center/scatter/protocol and category
Synthetic fixtures, successful smoke, model digests and hashes do not prove human validity or authenticity

global_state.next_scientific_gate: D01: independent original portraits and a pinned native observer. Resolve I01/I02/I04/I08 and D05 as applicable first; do not substitute more synthetic interval tightening.
global_state.legacy_boundary: Top-level mathematical modules and legacy CLI remain available for compatibility/research; they are not uniformly active, validated or equivalent to all historical section titles.

Real-use recovery, lifecycle, scale, utility and operational governance.

items.title: No delivered, validated native model/runtime pair
items.consequence: Automatic native observation has an implementation, but this checkout supplies neither model weights nor completed live-model acceptance. A digest or API fixture is not native accuracy.
items.next_action: Acquire an explicit model/runtime pair for the intended machine; retain origin, model SHA-256 and exact runtime; run observer-smoke and the live provider test with a legitimate supplied portrait.
items.done_when: A distinct run retains native process outputs and actual observation/no-face/multiple-face outcomes; human-reference accuracy remains separately gated by D01.

items.title: Real study and query templates contain replacement values and absent assets
items.consequence: Example filenames, group/lineage identifiers, sampling design and schematic coordinates are not an enrolled independent portrait study. Structural sample counts are not sample-size justification.
items.next_action: Populate a new study outside historical evidence with actual original images, blinded source-coordinate labels, dependent-group membership, exclusions and justified enrollment. Replace every schematic coordinate and REPLACE value.
items.done_when: Workspace status and freeze validate complete source/rater inventory; the study design explains group independence and category-specific enrollment before acquisition.

items.title: Source-routing thresholds are schematic engineering values
items.consequence: pixel_clear/pixel_smooth and thresholds such as detail 0.30/0.05 have no established real-portrait qualification. Reusing their names does not establish comparable acquisition.
items.next_action: Design the intended measurement policy using source-only development data; freeze apertures, all group members, thresholds and required categories before calibration/evaluation.
items.done_when: A new frozen policy has an explicit development rationale and retained source measurements; unseen/ambiguous categories still withhold deployment without pooled fallback.

items.title: Synthetic labs and native API controls remain deliberately synthetic
items.consequence: Engineered positive/negative controls test plumbing, containment and refusal. Blank raster/fake .task/API patching does not establish real inference, human accuracy, exchangeability or externally authentic history.
items.next_action: Retain these regression controls and explicit labels. Add separate native and independent-reference runs; never relabel existing fixtures or replace their evidence.
items.done_when: Reports identify synthetic, native smoke and real-reference validation as distinct evidence layers with actual outcomes.

items.title: ModelAdapter is an extension interface with no concrete telemetry provider
items.consequence: capture/intervene raise NotImplementedError. Optional torch helpers do not expose private model activations, attention or historical reasoning.
items.next_action: Only if a separately authorized research task needs telemetry, implement an adapter for an accessible model with explicit capture/intervention contracts and provenance; otherwise document the extension boundary.
items.done_when: Adapter tests execute actual accessible-model behavior and distinguish captured arrays from synthetic inputs; no implication of private-model access.

items.title: Research registry contains missing methods and non-equivalent proxies
items.consequence: Coverage by section number is not mathematical implementation coverage. Missing/proxy groups include SPD geometry, higher-dimensional persistence, optimized OT/GW, Jacobian SVD, concept probes, Bayesian evidence, exact wavelets/scattering, camera/3D models, causal counterfactuals and information-bottleneck training.
items.next_action: Use legacy_capability_gaps in this file to route claims to the actual primitive. Correct public naming/documentation or commission a specific method only when justified; these gaps do not supersede the real-reference gate.
items.done_when: Each claimed method has an explicit implemented/proxy/absent status, contract and appropriate independent numerical validation; retained historical mappings remain distinguishable.

items.title: Complete the first independent real-portrait native study
items.consequence: The software can describe a qualification protocol, but no retained real-reference native result currently establishes human localization delivery/coverage.
items.next_action: After platform and annotation blockers are resolved, freeze a prospectively justified native study; acquire once per eligible case; fit mean/scatter on development, radii on calibration and evaluate every required held-out category without retuning.
items.done_when: Completed acquisition, raw source-coordinate error rows, complete group denominators, category delivery/coverage and a truthful admitted/withheld result are retained. A failed criterion remains failed.

items.title: Close platform, installed-wheel and final-archive validation gaps
items.consequence: Current Windows source/wheel/archive suites all fail; milestone qualification and its raw-state-invariance check cannot complete. Historical Linux success does not certify this machine or current dependency versions.
items.next_action: Fix confirmed blockers; execute the supported OS/Python matrix and final-fingerprint tests, milestone-lab, verify/replay, outside-source wheel installation and extracted final-archive validation. Add these artifact/lab checks to CI rather than only building a wheel.
items.done_when: Raw commands, environment, exit codes and skip reasons are retained per platform; source/wheel/archive package bytes match; qualification changes no observed arrays; no source-tree import leakage.

items.title: Define tested dependency combinations and reproducible uv setup
items.consequence: Unbounded lower-only dependencies allow untested future stacks; current OpenCV 5 is already incompatible. The local lock predates Wave10 and CI independently resolves packages.
items.next_action: Regenerate the existing uv lock against current project metadata; establish tested core/native constraints and a documented locked setup. Keep existing environments and retained historical stacks recoverable.
items.done_when: A fresh locked environment installs the correct project version and passes relevant core/native gates; lock drift is detected; unsupported combinations fail clearly.

items.title: Provide evidence-preserving recovery for interrupted annotation imports
items.consequence: A label published before its receipt leaves an orphan and blocks status/freeze. Refusal preserves integrity, but there is no automated recovery command.
items.next_action: Specify and implement explicit inspect/export/reconcile or fork-to-new-workspace recovery with retained original bytes and operator decisions; do not silently discard or promote orphan files.
items.done_when: Fault-injected crashes before/after label and receipt publication have documented recoverable outcomes; frozen revision history remains complete.

items.title: Resolve workbench raster-center and pointer-transform validation before real labeling
items.consequence: The image is drawn from a canvas edge origin, while sourceAt directly divides edge-relative coordinates and exports them as integer-center raster coordinates. The formula maps displayed pixel i center to i+0.5; CSS canvas borders add another transform concern. Full pointer/browser confirmation did not run: local headless Chromium exited 2147483651 before producing a result.
items.next_action: Use an indexed raster fixture to check pixel centers and edge pixels through actual click/export at fit, pan, zoom, CSS border and devicePixelRatio variations. Establish one explicit source-to-canvas transform and its inverse; version any changed annotation convention instead of rewriting old labels.
items.done_when: Real browser pointer/export tests recover known integer pixel centers without half-pixel or border offsets; roundtrip imports preserve image binding and provenance.

items.title: Make offline browser interactions reproducible on supported hosts
items.consequence: Several QA drivers hardcode /usr/bin/chromium; Playwright is not a declared dev extra. Historical set_content fallback checks do not prove file-URL navigation, adjacent links or persistent offline draft storage.
items.next_action: Provide a portable browser-path/dependency setup and run actual emitted file bundles, keyboard/pointer edits, rater isolation, undo/redo, draft restore, downloads, filter equality and offline links. Retain fallback scope explicitly.
items.done_when: Desktop/mobile interaction logs and exported data comparisons pass on supported browsers; file navigation/link checks are distinct from screenshots and in-memory HTML tests.

items.title: Verify bounded worker lifecycle and quiet Windows launches
items.consequence: The worker captures streams and times out its direct process, but does not set an explicit Windows no-window flag or contain descendant processes. Native behavior on the intended host remains unvalidated.
items.next_action: Use hidden background launches on Windows, verify timeout/crash/interruption and any child-process cleanup, and retain process outcomes. If an interactive helper is necessary, honor the requested secondary-monitor placement without foregrounding the primary display.
items.done_when: Native failure controls leave no stray worker/window, preserve all attempt artifacts, and do not retry a failed case into success.

items.title: Measure large-study cost before designing evidence deduplication
items.consequence: Qualification copies the acquisition tree; admitted pairs embed complete qualification snapshots; HTML embeds source previews. Repeated queries multiply raw study storage and replay cost.
items.next_action: Benchmark intended enrollment sizes, image dimensions, peak memory, finalization/replay time, bundle bytes and VS Code indexing. If required, design content-addressed reuse with preserved self-contained export and exact replay semantics.
items.done_when: Published size/time/memory limits and recovery behavior are tested; any deduplication retains original rasters, labels, attempts and portable verifiability.

items.title: Evaluate usable geometry and hidden shift separately from finite delivery
items.consequence: Finite error radii or accepted coverage do not establish narrow/useful shape conclusions or immunity to within-category shift. Gradient routing is not calibrated face-quality recognition.
items.next_action: Prespecify interval-width, denominator-collapse, unresolved-relation and rater-disagreement analyses plus relevant acquisition shifts. Report abstentions and utility alongside delivery/coverage; propose new fits only from development evidence.
items.done_when: Held-out results include all groups and utility/missingness by frozen category; no threshold or model is tuned after seeing evaluation.

items.title: Expand beyond reference8 only after its real performance is characterized
items.consequence: Eight calibrated reference points do not validate all 478 model vertices, landmark-guided contours, interpolated deformation, occlusion or 3D anatomy.
items.next_action: If justified after D01/D09, acquire independent contour/visibility/depth evidence with new explicit protocols. Preserve raw 2D observations and keep new evidence scoped to the supported anatomy.
items.done_when: Every added anatomical claim has independent labels, appropriate error accounting and a versioned protocol; existing reference8 results are unchanged.

items.title: Prespecify cross-study selection and deployment monitoring
items.consequence: All-category acceptance controls a frozen study; repeated adaptive studies/model selection and post-deployment monitoring are not controlled by that policy.
items.next_action: Before operational deployment, specify how studies/models are selected, how repeated looks spend error, and what changes trigger a new frozen study. Record failures instead of selecting the first passing rerun.
items.done_when: A prospectively frozen monitoring/selection policy is evaluated separately from single-study acceptance.

items.title: Validate timing and endpoint provenance before using original video inputs
items.consequence: inspect_video uses CFR index/FPS time while retaining decoded timestamps. VFR timing and unmixed portrait endpoints are unvalidated; rank-one crossfades are explicitly not resemblance evidence.
items.next_action: If video becomes a substantive input, define timestamp/decoding behavior and verify real endpoints/ROI. Preserve the negative crossfade control and separate temporal diagnostics from anatomical pair evidence.
items.done_when: CFR/VFR fixtures validate selected-frame timestamps and source provenance; no temporal low-rank statistic becomes a face similarity score.

items.title: Replace wave-specific publication assumptions with a current create-only runner
items.consequence: Historical scripts hardcode wave paths, wheel versions and expected counts; some overwrite summary/log destinations. Reusing them for a new release can mix old evidence with current commands.
items.next_action: Keep historical scripts/evidence intact. Add a parameterized current release workflow that derives version/parent digest/test counts from actual artifacts, uses fresh destinations, preserves failures and seals a manifest after final bytes.
items.done_when: A clean staged release can be rebuilt and independently verified without changing an earlier record or assuming a fixed test count.

items.title: Separate the active checkout map from sealed archive inventories
items.consequence: The root release manifest inventories the sealed Wave10 distribution, not every file in the accumulated checkout. Prior waves and large evidence trees are intentional history; treating them as live source creates IDE and authority confusion.
items.next_action: Document current source/test/config ownership and release-specific manifests. Use IDE exclusions or a small source-focused workspace view if needed; retain original packages/evidence and LFS policy.
items.done_when: Agents and developers can identify current code, historical records and local ignored runs without deleting evidence or falsely declaring manifest corruption.

items.title: Bound legacy numerical APIs before promoting them into active evidence
items.consequence: Retained generic helpers have weaker shape/range/degeneracy and mutation contracts than Observation. Existing tests do not certify every domain or optional model/3D path.
items.next_action: For any actively used helper, specify units, valid cardinalities, degeneracies, finite inputs and mutation behavior; use adversarial numerical fixtures. Prefer the existing active contracts when integrating; keep unrelated research conditional.
items.done_when: Promoted functions have meaningful contract tests and explicit unsupported-input errors; no new alignment or score bypasses CanonicalState.

items.title: Windows finalization copies its own locked runner file
items.consequence: shutil.copytree runs while .runner.lock has a Windows byte-range lock. WinError 33 breaks study-finalize, milestone-lab and qualification replay; 83 current setup errors and two direct failures share this boundary.
items.next_action: Snapshot stable session content while retaining the writer lock; omit ephemeral lock bytes and recreate any required lock sentinel under a defined inventory policy. Do not unlock before the snapshot and introduce a concurrent-writer race.
items.done_when: Windows finalization and replay pass; concurrent-writer refusal remains intact; source/wheel/archive suites and raw-array-invariance tests complete.

items.title: Allowed OpenCV 5 dependency lacks the Haar API used by locate_faces
items.consequence: With opencv-python 5.0.0.93, cv2.CascadeClassifier is absent and the blank-raster locator test raises AttributeError. A supported install can therefore break the coarse locator.
items.next_action: Declare a tested compatible OpenCV range or implement a supported locator backend; explicitly capability-check optional detector assets/APIs and raise ProviderUnavailable with a concrete reason.
items.done_when: Supported dependency stacks return the documented empty coarse-locator result on a blank raster; incompatible stacks fail clearly without fake landmarks.

items.title: ZIP filename checks inspect already-normalized names
items.consequence: A raw ZIP member a\b is accepted as a/b on Windows; a raw member a�b is accepted as a. ZipInfo.orig_filename retains the forbidden bytes/characters while filename has normalized/truncated them. This defeats the declared name-rejection contract; the probe did not establish traversal outside the extraction root.
items.next_action: Validate the original decoded archive name and its equivalence to the accepted portable representation before constructing destinations; reject NUL/backslash and existing traversal/ADS/device/collision hazards.
items.done_when: Raw-byte malformed ZIPs are rejected consistently on Windows/Linux/macOS before writing; valid deterministic qualification snapshots still verify/replay.

items.title: Report module cannot parse on declared Python 3.11
items.consequence: The single-quoted f-string contains r['quantile'] using the same quote delimiter. Actual Python 3.11.14 reports SyntaxError: f-string: unmatched [. Rendering/import paths using the module cannot run on that declared supported version.
items.next_action: Rewrite the expression with Python 3.11-compatible quoting or precomputed values while preserving the existing support declaration; run the real interpreter, not only a newer parser feature_version check.
items.done_when: All source/scripts/tests parse on actual supported interpreters and the Python 3.11 study/report and CLI tests pass.

items.title: Committed lock and generated metadata identify the project as 0.8.0
items.consequence: Project/source version is 0.10.0 while uv.lock and tracked egg-info say 0.8.0. Locked setup and metadata consumers do not have one authoritative current package identity.
items.next_action: Regenerate uv.lock from the current package; verify the resulting dependency change. Stop treating stale generated egg-info as source authority, and regenerate/untrack it through an explicit packaging cleanup without touching release archives.
items.done_when: Project, lock, installed metadata and wheel version agree; a locked check succeeds; historical artifacts retain their original versions.

items.title: Packaging script includes ignored environments/runs and overwrites a fixed archive
items.consequence: Recursive packaging excludes only a small cache set. It includes .venv, .uv-cache, .commit-audit, runs and nested packages archives when present; Git ignores do not affect it. It writes ../facemath.zip and its sidecar in overwrite mode and does not regenerate the release manifest.
items.next_action: Build from an explicit clean release staging inventory with versioned create-only outputs. Exclude local environments/runs and unintended historical payloads; generate the final manifest from staged bytes and verify both ZIP and extraction. Inspect selection in dry-run mode before packaging this checkout.
items.done_when: A staging test containing sentinel local/cache/old-archive files excludes them; existing output refuses replacement; final inventory, wheel bytes, extraction tests and replay pass.

items.title: Backslash rejection test does not write the intended raw ZIP name on Windows
items.consequence: Constructing ZipInfo with a backslash normalizes the member name before writing on Windows. The test therefore asks the loader to reject an ordinary slash path and fails for the wrong fixture; real raw-name acceptance remains separately confirmed as I03.
items.next_action: Construct malformed local/central ZIP header names as raw bytes or use a fixture whose stored names are verified independently. Assert orig_filename/raw representation before calling the loader.
items.done_when: The same malicious bytes reach the loader on every target OS; benign a/b is accepted and actual a\b/NUL names are rejected.

items.title: Held-out region measurements shrink their published denominator
items.consequence: After filtering visible indices, heldout RMS/change use len(ids) for both support and total. A four-point nose with point 12 off-image reports geometry.nose.rms as 3/4 but registration.heldout_nose.rms/change as 3/3, hiding the same missing point.
items.next_action: Use the already retained total_ids as the held-out total; keep the observed-support numerator and missing-value behavior. Check all regional measurement ledgers for the same denominator collapse.
items.done_when: Partial, wholly missing and fully observed regions retain their declared totals consistently in raw JSON and HTML; original coordinates/fit results remain unchanged.

items.title: Percentile bootstrap uses a different tie policy from its point estimate
items.consequence: For baseline [1,1,1], value 1 and lower-is-more-similar, percentile is 50 but bootstrap interval is [0,0]. The bootstrap estimates a different statistic because <= replaces the point estimator's midrank tie policy.
items.next_action: Use one explicit percentile/tie definition for point and bootstrap estimates in both directions; add tied/discrete and non-tied controls.
items.done_when: All-equal baseline point and bootstrap are consistent; documented percentile orientation remains stable. Do not alter the separate active observation.cohort semantics inadvertently.

items.title: Frame digest omits array shape and dtype
items.consequence: Legacy Frame hashes raw bytes only and truncates to 16 hex characters. Zero RGB arrays shaped [8,12,3] and [12,8,3] receive the same fingerprint despite different source geometry.
items.next_action: Define a versioned digest over dtype, shape and contiguous bytes, preferably using the active full-SHA array contract. Preserve legacy digest interpretation for historical reports rather than silently relabeling them.
items.done_when: Different shapes/dtypes cannot collide solely through identical byte streams; compatibility behavior and provenance migration are explicit.

items.title: Frozen legacy dataclasses still alias writable NumPy arrays
items.consequence: np.asarray and frozen=True do not own immutable bytes. Mutating caller arrays can change legacy frames, landmarks, cohorts or measurement state after construction, undermining their immutable-state/provenance interpretation.
items.next_action: Copy and freeze owned numerical storage or narrow/document the mutable contract. Use the active contracts.frozen_array pattern where compatible; retain deliberate mutable result/ledger APIs.
items.done_when: Caller-buffer and returned-buffer mutation tests cannot change a supposedly frozen legacy input/state or its recorded provenance.

items.title: minimum_valid_support is an ineffective EngineConfig setting
items.consequence: The configuration declares minimum_valid_support, but quality assessment hardcodes 0.20 and never reads the setting. Changing the public option cannot change its intended quality gate.
items.next_action: Pass the configured threshold into quality assessment with range validation, or explicitly retire the unused option with compatibility handling.
items.done_when: Two declared thresholds around a controlled support fraction produce the expected different quality decisions.

items.title: Median of calibrated domain percentiles is labeled as a calibrated consensus percentile
items.consequence: calibrated_consensus returns a median of domain summaries without calibrating the aggregate statistic against a joint reference cohort. Individual calibrated marginals do not make their median a population-calibrated percentile.
items.next_action: Label the result as a descriptive aggregate and remove the population-percentile implication, or require a separately specified/calibrated joint statistic with dependence and held-out validation.
items.done_when: Legacy reports cannot present this uncalibrated aggregate as a resemblance probability or population percentile; active instrument outputs remain unchanged.

items.title: Zero-shift Laplacian eigensolver fails on a valid small mesh
items.consequence: laplace_beltrami_eigensystem requests shift-invert at sigma=0 on a Laplacian with a constant nullspace. Vertices [[0,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0]], face [[0,1,2]] reproduce RuntimeError: Factor is exactly singular. HKS/WKS/spectral distances depend on this path.
items.next_action: Handle the constant nullspace with an appropriate eigensolver/shift or constrained basis; validate small, disconnected and degenerate meshes and define admissible k.
items.done_when: Valid connected small meshes return sorted finite modes with expected nullity; unsupported/degenerate inputs fail explicitly; HKS/WKS invariants are checked.

items.title: Persistence comparison silently drops unmatched components
items.consequence: persistence_distance_0d compares only min(len(pa),len(pb)) deaths. Points [[0,0],[1,0]] and [[0,0],[1,0],[100,0]] return distance 0 after the additional long-lived component is discarded.
items.next_action: Reject unsupported unequal-cardinality comparisons or implement a correctly specified persistence-diagram matching rule including unmatched deaths/diagonal cost. Keep the 0D-only scope explicit.
items.done_when: Adding a distant component cannot silently yield equality; singleton/empty/cardinality cases have a defined finite result or explicit error.

items.title: Finalization/validation errors discard their partial execution journals
items.consequence: These paths accumulate actual Journal events in memory, persist them only near success and remove the temporary tree on exceptions. A failed finalization may leave the original acquisition intact but loses its own partial stage journal and intermediate validation output.
items.next_action: Preserve a create-only failed-run record containing the actual partial journal, exception and any committed diagnostic artifacts before cleanup. Distinguish failed output from a valid bundle and never overwrite an earlier failure.
items.done_when: Injected failures at qualification/validation/export stages retain inspectable actual events without an invented completion event or invalid successful manifest.

handoff_rules.next_step: Choose one finding ID or a tightly coupled blocker group; expand its implementation design and validation details against the cited source before editing.
before_source_edits: Read README, current milestone design and AGENTS.md
Use the actual parent archive; record its digest and baseline without fabricating missing bytes
Preserve this review baseline and every pre-fix failure; create new run destinations
after_source_edits: Run python -m pytest -q from the actual package
Run milestone-lab, verify and replay with the final code fingerprint
Assert every raw observed-state array is unchanged by added qualification
Build/install wheel outside the source tree; verify import location and package bytes; test there
Extract the final archive and repeat required validation; retain commands/environment/return codes/raw logs/skips
Report implementation, runtime, package, native-model and human-reference outcomes separately
handoff_rules.review_refresh: Reconcile finding IDs against new evidence after fixes; do not silently erase this baseline or rewrite sealed historical outputs.
